title: Startup dependency checks with fast-fail
description:
Validate all external dependencies at startup and exit immediately with a clear error if any are unavailable.

Why this issue exists:
Both daemons currently start even when Kubo is unreachable, SQLite paths are unwritable, or TLS certs are invalid. This leads to confusing runtime failures instead of a clear startup error.

What needs to be done:
- Kubo reachability and SQLite validation on startup
- TLS cert/key and signing key validation
- Admin bind address availability check
- --check CLI flag for dry-run validation without starting servers
